finding: W57 could not produce a controller-authored finding ledger, so no closed-owner repair transaction was ever opened. The three owning requirement IDs were always correct, but the bytes carrying them were never inside the only input the controller routes on.
observed_failure: state.json persisted findings_path=null, closed_owner_repair=false and owner_stack=[] across every prior W57 dispatch, and zero *-findings.json ledgers exist in the run directory, despite a complete wave-local routing artifact having been written at dispatch 6.
hypothesis: W57-REPAIR170-STDOUT-TAIL-IS-ONLY-ROUTER-INPUT - under the v2 fragment contract the controller's own result builder never sets a findings key, so the sole routable payload is the documented fallback output[-1600:] of worker stdout. Positioning the owning IDs inside that window makes route_findings produce the closed-owner rows that unit_run could never trigger.

root_cause_in_controller_source.site_1_fragment_parser: .opencode/scripts/run-wave-program.py:276-303 - _parse_fragment_machine_result builds the result from status/meta/handoff fragments only and never assigns a findings key, so a v2 result structurally cannot carry a findings array.
root_cause_in_controller_source.site_2_fallback: .opencode/scripts/run-wave-program.py:4287-4293 - result['findings'] = [output[-1600:]] only when status is REOPEN/BLOCKED/FAIL/HUMAN_DEFERRED. This is the sole routable payload for a v2 fragment result.
root_cause_in_controller_source.site_3_routing_trigger: .opencode/scripts/run-wave-program.py:6027-6031 - route_findings runs for node 'repair' when status is not in {READY_FOR_AUDIT, PASS, READY}. unit_run is not a routing trigger; repair with REOPEN is.
root_cause_in_controller_source.site_4_transaction_event: .opencode/scripts/run-wave-program.py:6049-6055 - closed_owner_repair_transaction events are emitted only inside the routed branch.
root_cause_in_controller_source.site_5_pivot_order: .opencode/scripts/run-wave-program.py:3014-3034 - routed_owner sorts non-current owners ascending by wave number, so the controller pivot is W16, not W55.
root_cause_in_controller_source.router: .opencode/scripts/route-wave-findings.py:204-208 - phase-result findings blobs are scanned for requirement ids and resolved against the owner index built from wave frontmatter.
